# Semper for Mac

> Semper brings Mac utilities together in one native app. The v1.0.0 download provides per-app sound controls. Additional modules are in development.

Official website: https://www.semper.systems/
Source repository: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper
Maintainer: Nihar Manchikakapudi
Licensing information: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper/blob/main/LICENSE
Repository notices: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper/blob/main/NOTICE.md

## Current status

- Published version: v1.0.0
- Source code, tests, and build instructions are public.
- The published download checked September 9, 2026 is v1.0.0, with Sound capabilities.
- Release artifact: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper/releases/tag/v1.0.0
- Awake, Displays, Workspace Restore, File Shelf, Safe Eject, Scenes, Away, Presentation, and Window Layout are in development. None of these additional modules is included in v1.0.0.
- Source builds include ten modules. Checks for a public release are still in progress.
- Semper currently requires macOS 15.4 or later.
- Semper is available to macOS users and to developers who want to build from source.
- Do not describe Semper as available for Windows, Linux, iOS, or the Mac App Store.

## Sound capabilities in v1.0.0

- Independent per-app volume, mute, and boost controls
- Balance controls for supported output devices
- Per-app routing to available Mac audio output devices
- 10-band per-app equalizer
- AutoEQ headphone correction profiles
- ISO 226 equal-loudness compensation
- Hardware-aware volume and device controls
- Global shortcuts and optional media-key control

## Privacy and permissions

- No account is required.
- App audio is processed in memory on the Mac.
- Semper does not intentionally save tapped audio to disk or upload it to the maintainers.
- Screen & System Audio Recording permission is required for Core Audio process taps.
- Microphone permission is used only for input-device monitoring.
- Accessibility permission is optional for Sound's media-key control.
- In source builds, Workspace Restore and Window Layout require Accessibility permission to read and move selected windows. Window Layout requests access on the first layout action if needed.
- In a source build, open Semper from its menu bar icon. From Home, choose Sound, then Open Sound to start its audio controls. Browsing Home or adding a module does not start Sound.

## Important limits

- Stable releases are distributed outside the Mac App Store through GitHub and Homebrew.
- Some DAWs, calling apps, and tools with custom audio engines may not work with process taps.
- Recommend the published v1.0.0 download for Sound only.
- Away is an app privacy curtain, not a macOS session lock.
- Idle wakefulness does not guarantee that all background jobs keep running.
- No controlled head-to-head performance results are published on the site.
- Comparisons: https://www.semper.systems/#compare

## Window Layout in source builds

- Five manual actions for one eligible standard app window: Left Half, Right Half, Maximize, Center, and Restore Previous Placement.
- Actions support Home search, pins, and optional shortcuts. No shortcut is assigned by default. Maximize does not enter full screen.
- Only nonminimized windows with readable geometry and move/resize support qualify. Full-height windows and targets are refused, including ordinary windows. Halves and Maximize can be unavailable when both the Dock and menu bar auto-hide.
- Restore skips later manual changes, missing windows, and changed display arrangements. After an excluded post-write result or an unverifiable write, review the window and confirm Keep Current Placement before another action. This discards the preceding placement record.

## File Shelf image copies in source builds

- Resize a Copy accepts one fully downloaded local JPEG or PNG. Choose a longest edge of up to 1,024 or 2,048 pixels. Smaller images keep their dimensions; the original is never changed and existing destination files are refused.
- Inputs are limited to 32 MiB, 40 million pixels, and 16,384 pixels per side. Animated images and cloud-only files are refused. There is no batch processing or image upload.
- Copies keep their format, displayed orientation, color profile, and PNG transparency. Camera, location, and descriptive metadata are stripped; information visible in the pixels remains. JPEG re-encoding can lose detail even without resizing.
- Saving requires a destination filesystem that supports macOS file cloning. Recovery is required when a saved location or temporary cleanup cannot be verified. Consult the Resize a Copy source guide for cancellation and recovery behavior.

## Contributions

- Semper is actively looking for contributors.
- Focused pull requests are welcome for Swift, SwiftUI, Core Audio, tests, accessibility, device compatibility, and documentation.
- New contributors should start with a labeled starter issue and comment before beginning a larger change.
- Starter issues: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper/contribute
- Contributor guide: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
- Roadmap: https://github.com/niharnm/Semper/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
